resharper_csharp_indent_invocation_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent method calls' parenthesis. Implemented. The four values set two numbers, contents and closing delimiter, in levels from the line the opener is on: none 0/0, inside 1/0, outside 1/1, outside_and_inside 2/1. Measured on a chopped call whose ) this export's wrap keys put on a line of its own; Skala and the oracle agree at all four values on constructs/indentation/delimiter-indent.cs.

Typeone of inside, outside, outside_and_inside, none
Defaultinside

resharper_csharp_indent_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent other parenthesis and brackets. Implemented, and not inert. ⚠ The previous entry recorded it measured-inert: "the oracle returns the file unchanged at inside, none and outside_and_inside". That was a fact about the probe. The M11 probe had no input where a delimiter this key governs lands on a line of its own, because nothing in this export's wrapping puts one there — but keep_user_linebreaks = true keeps one the author wrote, and arr[a + b\n] moves its ] in by one level at outside and outside_and_inside. Skala agrees at three of four values; at none the oracle gives the stray ] the level of its opener's line and Skala leaves it on the ambient continuation (SK-DIV-0041's shape).

resharper_csharp_indent_primary_constructor_decl_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent primary constructor declarations' parenthesis. Implemented. ⚠ Its closer half is masked — wrap_before_primary_constructor_declaration_rpar = false keeps the ) on the last parameter's line — but its contents half is not: at none the oracle puts a record's parameters at the declaration's own column. Skala agrees at three of four values. ⚠ SK-DIV-0043 at one value: at outside_and_inside the oracle gives the contents one level where the table says two. The second level is realised only where the construct chops at its opener — a call and a parameter list do, a filled list whose first item stays on the opener's line does not — and that is a fact the fitter knows and the builder does not.

resharper_csharp_indent_statement_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent statement (if, while, for, etc) parenthesis. Read — ConditionLevels consults it — and inert under this export, which is a mask and not a gap: align_multiline_statement_conditions = true lays a condition and its ) out from an absolute column, and a level count has nothing to say about a column. All four values return the same file while that key is on; turn it off and the family's contents/closer table applies here like anywhere else.

resharper_csharp_indent_typeparam_angles #

Parenthesis — Indent type parameter's angles. Implemented, and not inert. ⚠ The earlier entry recorded it measured-inert on "a declaration with two type parameters and two constraints"; that file's > never reached a line of its own and neither did its contents wrap. On constructs/breaks/type-parameter-list.cs, whose list the oracle fills at its own commas, the continuation moves at every value: none 0, inside/outside 1, outside_and_inside 2. Skala agrees at three of four. ⚠ SK-DIV-0043 at one value: at outside_and_inside the oracle gives the contents one level where the table says two. The second level is realised only where the construct chops at its opener — a call and a parameter list do, a filled list whose first item stays on the opener's line does not — and that is a fact the fitter knows and the builder does not. ⚠ The key's closer half is separately out of reach: the shape is a > on a line of its own, and SK-DIV-0042 is that Skala rejoins the author's break before one where the oracle keeps it.
